title: Boda boda commuter 150
reference: East African boda boda taxi of the Bajaj Boxer BM150 / TVS HLX family (generic, unbranded), in typical taxi fit-out
wheels: 17 in 36-spoke chrome wire wheels, 2.75-17 ribbed front and 3.00-17 block-tread rear tyres, drum brakes front (cable) and rear (rod)
engine: 150 cc air-cooled OHV single, cylinder inclined 15 deg forward, kick start, carburettor with rubber hose to side air box, chrome header and silencer with heat shield on the right; 4-speed chain drive in a full enclosed chain case
colours: Gloss black frame and body with red tank side panels and silver pinstripe, red side-panel bands, chrome mudguards, crash guards, dress guard and exhaust, silver engine
weak_points: The full chain case is still a large plain black loft that dominates the lower left side; the tank's red panel edge shows faceting at render resolution; the seat is a smooth loft without a fabric texture; the dress guard grille is a simple radial/arc wire grid rather than a pressed perforated panel.
